💡 *Nuru House Hair Care Tips*

*For wigs:*
• Store on a wig stand when not in use
• Wash with cold water and wig-safe shampoo
• Detangle gently from ends to roots
• Use heat protectant before styling

*For weaves & sew-ins:*
• Keep your scalp moisturised
• Sleep with a satin bonnet or pillowcase
• Avoid product buildup at the roots
